start.name_zh: 16#阀室（垫江县砚台镇，EIA原文OCR误作'热江县'）
start.name_en: Valve Chamber No. 16, Yantai Town, Dianjiang County
start.geocode_source: EIA Table 2.2-22 (row 9) states '16#阀室 | 热江县砚台镇 | 141.78 | 12.50' (热江县 is an OCR misread of 垫江县 -- no such county exists; 砚台镇/Dianjiang matches GEM's StartLocation 'Dianjiang'/'Valve Chamber No. 16'). No groundwater monitoring well was found tagged to 垫江县 in either EIA's well-coordinate tables (a targeted grep for the county name against all well-table rows returned nothing), so coordinate falls back to Nominatim query '砚台镇,垫江县,重庆市' -> OSM node 6234027412, town-level point (107.32E/30.1475N), which falls within the 垫江县 district boundary (Nominatim '垫江县,重庆市' bbox 29.97-30.52N/107.22-107.67E) as a sanity check.

end.name_zh: 垫江县（垫江供气支线/垫江供气管道）
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '垫江县,重庆市' -> OSM relation 2693275, county administrative-boundary centroid. Matches GEM's generic EndLocation='Dianjiang'.

corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the Phase 2 trunk at 16#阀室 in 砚台镇 (Dianjiang County) and running into Dianjiang County to serve local gas demand. Note: the trunk's own 垫江压气站 (Dianjiang compressor station, a separate larger facility on the same trunk, just downstream of 16#阀室 per Table 2.2-22 row 9's neighbor) is located in 垫江县杠家镇 (Ganjia Town) -- a different, nearby town, not used here since 16#阀室/砚台镇 is the more specific match to GEM's own field label ('Valve Chamber No. 16'). The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '垫江供气管道' among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches (combined 135.6km). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
researcher_notes: Township-level attribution for the start point is confirmed via direct table match; no document-stated coordinate exists for this specific town in either EIA (unlike 5 of the other 6 branches), so this is the one PID in the group relying purely on Nominatim rather than an EIA-sourced coordinate for its start point.
